name: The Night Watch
summary: Darkshire's volunteer militia faces restless dead rising across Duskwood. Commander Althea Ebonlocke sends travelers into the haunted barrows to hold the skeletal horrors back. The struggle helps keep Darkshire from falling to the darkness.

sections.title: The Dead Do Not Rest
sections.body: Duskwood's graveyards have grown unnaturally restless as the forest sinks into twilight. Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads Darkshire's volunteer militia, The Night Watch, against an endless siege. With no aid from Stormwind, her forces are stretched thin. Animated skeletons and other horrors rise from the earth and threaten the eastern settlements, so the militia calls on able travelers to enter the deadlands.

sections.title: Haunted Soil
sections.body: Two places draw the militia's attention: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, just south of town, and Raven Hill Graveyard, far to the west. Skeletons pull themselves from forgotten tombs and shallow graves beside the roads, stirred by dark magic lingering in the forest's shadows. Cutting them down gives Darkshire's beleaguered citizens room to breathe, but the battle against this entrenched evil never ends.

faq.q: Why is the Night Watch relying on travelers rather than Stormwind guards?
faq.answer: Stormwind has left Duskwood to defend itself, so Commander Althea Ebonlocke and her local militia hold the region. With strife in the capital and the king missing, no guards arrive to reinforce them, and the Night Watch turns to passing adventurers.

faq.q: Where are the skeletons coming from?
faq.answer: Skeletons claw their way from Tranquil Gardens Cemetery and Raven Hill Graveyard. Dark magic in the woods has disturbed old burials and raised the remains as violent, mindless sentries.
Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads the Night Watch. She is related to Darkshire's mayor, Lord Ello Ebonlocke, and directs the town's defense against Duskwood's undead and monstrous threats.

faq.q: What is the difference between Tranquil Gardens and Raven Hill?
faq.answer: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery lies just south of Darkshire and threatens the town nearby. Raven Hill Graveyard lies far to the west, across the forest, and is a vast burial ground at the heart of Duskwood's undead infestation.

faq.q: What happens after culling these skeletons?
faq.answer: Althea's campaign continues after the skeletons and fiends are cut down. The Night Watch watches for new threats across the forest, from ghouls and skeletons to more dangerous undead and the necromancers directing them deeper in Duskwood.

faq.q: Why is Darkshire in constant danger?
faq.answer: Duskwood was once a peaceful province of the Kingdom of Stormwind, but magical twilight and shadowy curses consumed it. Feral worgen, ravenous spiders, and restless undead overrun the woods, leaving Darkshire as the zone's last bastion of living humanity.

angles.text: Darkshire marks the Alliance's fragile southeastern border in the southern Eastern Kingdoms. Helping the Night Watch keeps the town a viable foothold instead of letting it fall to ruin.
For the Silver Hand and knights of the Light, facing the defiled dead in Tranquil Gardens is a sacred duty. They seek to cleanse corrupted resting places.
At Raven Hill, priests walk tainted soil and face the raw perversion of burial traditions. Their faith can bring quiet rest to tormented souls.
Many skeletons rising from Duskwood's earth are ancestors of living Stormwind and Darkshire citizens. For human defenders, the fight is deeply personal.
